// Generated by fizzyx. Do not edit.

import type { ReactNode } from "react"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })

const humanize = (value: string): string =>
  value.replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase())

function formatDetailValue(value: unknown, key: string): ReactNode {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>
  if (typeof value === "boolean") return <Badge variant="outline">{value ? "Yes" : "No"}</Badge>
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">{value.map((item, index) => <Badge key={index} variant="secondary">{typeof item === "object" ? JSON.stringify(item) : String(item)}</Badge>)}</div> : <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>
  if (typeof value === "object") return <dl className="grid gap-1.5">{Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).map(([nestedKey, nestedValue]) => <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" key={nestedKey}><dt className="min-w-24 text-xs font-medium capitalize text-muted-foreground">{nestedKey.replaceAll("_", " ")}</dt><dd className="text-sm text-foreground">{formatDetailValue(nestedValue, nestedKey)}</dd></div>)}</dl>
  const text = String(value)
  if (/(?:^|_)(?:created|updated|start|end)?_?at$|(?:date|time)$/i.test(key)) {
    const date = new Date(text)
    if (!Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return <time className="tabular-nums" dateTime={date.toISOString()} title={text}>{dateFormatter.format(date)}</time>
  }
  if (/(?:^|_)(?:status|state|type|role)$/i.test(key)) return <Badge variant="secondary">{humanize(text)}</Badge>
  if (/(?:url|link|website)$/i.test(key) && /^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) return <a className="text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline" href={text} rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">{text}</a>
  if (typeof value === "number") return <span className="tabular-nums">{text}</span>
  return <span className="break-words">{text}</span>
}

export function RecordDetails({ data }: { data: unknown }) {
  const entries = data && typeof data === "object" && !Array.isArray(data) ? Object.entries(data as Record<string, unknown>) : []
  return <Card>
    <CardHeader className="border-b"><CardTitle>Record Information</CardTitle><CardDescription>Values returned by the API for this record.</CardDescription></CardHeader>
    <CardContent className="p-0">
      {entries.length ? <dl className="divide-y">{entries.map(([key, value]) => <div className="grid gap-2 px-5 py-4 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(140px,0.35fr)_1fr]" key={key}><dt className="text-sm font-medium capitalize text-muted-foreground">{key.replaceAll("_", " ")}</dt><dd className="min-w-0 break-words text-sm text-foreground">{formatDetailValue(value, key)}</dd></div>)}</dl> : <p className="px-5 py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No record details are available.</p>}
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
}
